out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Unlabeled spray bottles with chemical under front handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. BOTTLES WERE LABELED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: A cardboard box was sitting on top of the only handwashing sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM MOVED BOX.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Boba
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. BOBA WAS DISCARDED BECAUSE IT WAS OUT OF TEMP CONTROL SINCE 10am.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the CFM with v/d clean up procedures for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: The food service employee was drinking from an open cup at the prep counter top in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: The food service employee removed the open drink from the kitchen area and discontinued activity for compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located by the 3 vat sink, is blocked by a large trash can, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the trash can for accessibility to the hand washing sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw frozen fish was stored in a container that was sitting on top of bean sprouts in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM relocated the fish and reorganized the walk in cooler.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: bean sprouts (49F) and chopped cabbage (45F) in ice bath, fish soup (43F) in #3
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: multiple bags of egg rolls, multiple containers of beef soups and fish soups, containers of cooked meats in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the food items with dates, during the inspection, for proper discard.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that multiple spray bottles of degreaser chemicals were being stored on open shelves above clean dishes and single service utensils.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM relocated the bottles of chemicals to prevent possible contamination.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: multiple containers of frozen raw fish stacked on top of each other at the counter of the 3 vat sink, thawing; boxes of raw frozen beef thawing stacked on top of each on the kitchen floor.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM untracked the containers of frozen raw fish and placed them, submerged, under running water for proper thawing. The boxes of meat were relocated to the walk in cooler.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple bottles of hoisin sauce, soy sauce, ginger sauce, vinegar, chili sauce near the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the bottles of sauces with the common names for proper identification.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: There were multiple large pots of pho soup being cooled directly on the ground. There were large containers of food items being stored on the floor in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM relocated all of the pots to the counter top, more than 6 inches off of the ground. The CFM will need to rearrange the walk in cooler to accommodate the food inventory and to store at least 6 inches above the ground.
